hypothesis: The fixed 448-pixel cache may discard useful fine image information; test genuine 768-pixel inputs from original images against upsampling the existing cache to the same size.
development_evidence: 48 of 48 sampled training originals exceed 768 pixels; typical original size 2600x2048, while all sampled caches are 448x448.
matched_controls: Identical fixed 5 percent crop, aspect padding, JPEG quality95/subsampling0, DINOv3-B weights, input size, class head configuration and seeds. The high-resolution source differs.
evaluation: All four configurations receive three seeds and three outer patient folds, with separate inner early-stopping patients. Passing candidates need repeated-patient confirmation before any external evaluation.
external_test_policy: Feature extraction is frozen and label-independent; no external outcomes are evaluated by this pipeline.
